description: Static review of MCP tool definitions, as returned by a server's tools/list, for how well a model can choose and call them. Flags missing, too-short or vague descriptions; parameters with no description or type; free-form objects and arrays without items; required fields that are not declared; duplicate, case-colliding or near-identical tools; missing or contradictory annotations (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint and friends); tool-poisoning phrasing that tells the model to override its instructions or hide actions from the user; and hidden zero-width, bidi or tag characters. Also estimates the token cost of the whole tool list. Nothing is fetched and no tool is called; the score is a heuristic for usability, not a security guarantee. Deterministic, no LLM.

tools.description: The tool definitions to check: each an object with name, description, inputSchema and optional title, outputSchema and annotations. Max 200 tools, 512 KB request body.

idempotentHint.description: Repeat calls have no extra effect.

inputSchema.description: A JSON Schema; for inputSchema, type "object" with properties.

outputSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema of the result.

tools_list.description: Alternative to tools: a raw tools/list result ({"tools": [...]}) pasted as-is.

name: mcp_tool_lint
